name: Bug eyed
summary: A cluster of eyeballs that all look the same way: their gaze wanders, darts on the music and often turns to stare at you; they blink on the beat and swell with their own bands.
credit: After vizz.fm's Bug Eyed (https://vizz.fm). No code used; written fresh.
hint: Every eye watches the same point, which drifts, darts on sharp sounds (Darting) and turns to look at you (Stare). Each beat makes some eyes blink; each eye swells with one band, lows in the middle; the bass widens the pupils; in quiet passages the lids droop.

params.label: Size mix
params.help: From all the same size to big and small mixed.

params.label: Stare
params.help: How often a new look is straight at you.

params.label: Darting
params.help: How often a sharp sound makes the gaze jump.

params.label: Blinks
params.help: The share of the eyes that blink on each beat.

params.help: How much each eye swells with its band.

params.label: Pupils
params.help: How much the bass widens the pupils.
